"""
Python ORM access layer for compound engineering problem #11.

This module provides SQLAlchemy ORM models and database access patterns
aligned with the compound engineering database schema, addressing all
domain constraints including material properties, structural integrity,
manufacturing tolerances, and quality control.
"""

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Optional, List, Any, Dict

from sqlalchemy import (
    Column,
    String,
    Numeric,
    DateTime,
    Boolean,
    ForeignKey,
    UniqueConstraint,
    CheckConstraint,
    Index,
    Integer,
    Float,
    Text,
    func,
)
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import (
    declarative_base,
    relationship,
    Session,
    sessionmaker,
)
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base

Base = declarative_base()


class Material(Base):
    """
    Master table for all materials used in engineering components.
    
    Domain constraints:
    - density must be > 0
    - youngs_modulus must be > 0
    - poissons_ratio must be >= 0 and < 0.5
    - yield_strength must be > 0
    - ultimate_tensile_strength must be > 0 and >= yield_strength
    - thermal_conductivity if present must be > 0
    - thermal_expansion_coefficient if present must be >= 0
    - Unique constraint on (material_name, material_grade)
    """
    
    __tablename__ = "materials"
    
    material_id = Column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True),
        primary_key=True,
        default=uuid.uuid4,
        nullable=False,
    )
    material_name = Column(
        String(255),
        nullable=False,
    )
    material_grade = Column(
        String(100),
        nullable=True,
    )
    density = Column(
        Numeric(10, 4),
        nullable=False,
    )
    youngs_modulus = Column(
        Numeric(12, 4),
        nullable=False,
    )
    poissons_ratio = Column(
        Numeric(5, 4),
        nullable=False,
    )
    yield_strength = Column(
        Numeric(12, 4),
        nullable=False,
    )
    ultimate_tensile_strength = Column(
        Numeric(12, 4),
        nullable=False,
    )
    thermal_conductivity = Column(
        Numeric(10, 4),
        nullable=True,
    )
    thermal_expansion_coefficient = Column(
        Numeric(12, 8),
        nullable=True,
    )
    created_at = Column(
        DateTime,
        nullable=False,
        default=datetime.utcnow,
    )
    updated_at = Column(
        DateTime,
        nullable=False,
        default=datetime.utcnow,
        onupdate=datetime.utcnow,
    )
    
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("material_name", "material_grade", name="uq_material_name_grade"),
        CheckConstraint("density > 0", name="ck_material_density_positive"),
        CheckConstraint("youngs_modulus > 0", name="ck_material_youngs_modulus_positive"),
        CheckConstraint(
            "poissons_ratio >= 0 AND poissons_ratio < 0.5",
            name="ck_material_poissons_ratio_range",
        ),
        CheckConstraint("yield_strength > 0", name="ck_material_yield_strength_positive"),
        CheckConstraint(
            "ultimate_tensile_strength > 0 AND ultimate_tensile_strength >= yield_strength",
            name="ck_material_uts_positive_and_ge_yield",

        CheckConstraint(
            "thermal_conductivity IS NULL OR thermal_conductivity > 0",
            name="ck_material_thermal_conductivity_positive",

            name="ck_material_thermal_expansion_non_negative",
        ),
        Index("idx_material_name", "material_name"),
        Index("idx_material_grade", "material_grade"),
    )
